pages.text:
BOTH OF YOU BEGIN WITH THREE COMPOSURE POINTS. A
MATCHING REPLY COSTS YOUR OPPONENT ONE POINT. A
WRONG REPLY OR A YIELDED EXCHANGE COSTS YOU ONE.
pages.raw_text: Both of you begin with three composure points. A matching reply costs your opponent one point. A wrong reply or a yielded exchange costs you one.

pages.text: THE FIRST PERSON AT ZERO YIELDS THE AGREED TOPIC.
pages.raw_text: The first person at zero yields the agreed topic.

pages.text:
THERE IS NO TIME LIMIT. YOU CAN REVIEW YOUR
NOTEBOOK BEFORE CHOOSING A REPLY.
pages.raw_text: There is no time limit. You can review your notebook before choosing a reply.

pages.text:
WHEN YOU READ OR HEAR A LINE, IT IS RECORDED. ITS
REPLY IS LEARNED SEPARATELY. PRACTICE AND THE
RECAP TEACH THE MATCHES YOU STILL NEED.
pages.raw_text: When you read or hear a line, it is recorded. Its reply is learned separately. Practice and the recap teach the matches you still need.

pages.text:
A LOSS KEEPS YOUR ITEMS, LEARNED REPLIES AND
PRACTICAL PROGRESS. REMATCHES STAY AVAILABLE. WIN
ALL FOUR CONTESTS BEFORE THE FINAL COMMITMENTS.
pages.raw_text: A loss keeps your items, learned replies and practical progress. Rematches stay available. Win all four contests before the final commitments.

pages.text:
SKIPPING SPEECH, PAUSING, OPENING A MENU, SAVING
OR LOADING DOES NOT YIELD AN EXCHANGE. USE THE
LABELED YIELD OPTION IF YOU WANT TO CONCEDE.
pages.raw_text: Skipping speech, pausing, opening a menu, saving or loading does not yield an exchange. Use the labeled yield option if you want to concede.

pages.text:
PRACTICE IS UNSCORED. READ THE LINE AND ITS
MATCHING REPLY, THEN TRY THE EXCHANGE. THE RECAP
EXPLAINS HOW THE WORDS ANSWER EACH OTHER.
pages.raw_text: Practice is unscored. Read the line and its matching reply, then try the exchange. The recap explains how the words answer each other.

pages.text:
THERE ARE REPLIES TO LEARN BEFORE THIS CONTEST.
PRACTICE WILL TEACH THE MISSING MATERIAL,
INCLUDING ANY EARLIER LINES YOU HAVE NOT MET YET.
pages.raw_text: There are replies to learn before this contest. Practice will teach the missing material, including any earlier lines you have not met yet.

pages.text:
YOU HAVE LEARNED THIS CONTEST'S FULL REPLY POOL.
YOU CAN COMPETE, PRACTICE AGAIN OR REVIEW THE
NOTEBOOK.

pages.text:
THAT REPLY ANSWERS THE LINE. NO SCORE IN PRACTICE;
THE MATCH IS RECORDED IN YOUR NOTEBOOK.

pages.text:

READ THE MATCHING REPLY AND THE EXPLANATION, THEN
TRY AGAIN.
